conditional_monoidal_extension.Cathedral_choice: z=Delta from the four-mode exterior prior
conditional_monoidal_extension.classification: Unitary covariance gives Q_H=p_H I_H; natural direct-sum factorization forces one common p, equivalently one fugacity z.
conditional_monoidal_extension.new_structural_premise: the V4 exterior fugacity is universal and monoidal on every history one-particle carrier

identity_quotient_obstruction.master_equivalence: K~K+bI in every normalized N=1 heat state
identity_quotient_obstruction.theorem: At fixed nonzero beta and fixed Delta, the full-Fock extension is not invariant on [K]=K+R I unless b=0 or one conditions on fixed N.

possible_sections_of_the_quotient.fixed_mean_number: choose the chemical potential from a declared mean occupancy; unique after beta and K are supplied, but the mean is a new premise
possible_sections_of_the_quotient.fixed_number_sector: condition on N=1; recovers the existing theory but forfeits the full fermionic entropy spectral action
possible_sections_of_the_quotient.minimum_zero: replace K by K-lambda_min(K)I; preserves positivity but is a new spectral-zero prescription and is nonsmooth at level crossings
possible_sections_of_the_quotient.trace_zero: replace K by K-Tr(K)I/n; canonical and linear but generally destroys the positive-Gram interpretation

verdict.advance: Universally copying Delta is the strongest target-blind full-Fock repair found, but it conflicts exactly with the existing identity-shift quotient.  Co-shifting chemical potential or choosing a cost zero is unavoidable additional structure.
